purpose: Isolate INVARIANT orchestration from CLI/app-server context and provider cache differences
scope: Same stock Codex CLI through INVARIANT generic command runner versus standalone Docker. Not the optimized native CodexRunner.
initial_input_controls: actual first-request input tokens equal per role
cache_controls: pair-specific developer nonce in both arms
cache_limit: Provider prefix-cache placement and hits cannot be forced equal from this ChatGPT CLI configuration. A fresh CLI home does not imply a cold server cache.
timing: Sum of methods critical-path stage + checker stage + export. Excludes initial fixture/image/SDK preparation, metadata collection and cleanup in both arms; native baseline checks/checkpoints/evaluation are included.
maintenance: Shared global GC gate held throughout each pair; no concurrent benchmark pairs.
pricing_limit: Historical comparison weights, not actual account bill or current USD pricing. Outer author/debug work excluded from paired workload totals.
